test_policy.notes: First-year applicants choose whether to have SAT/ACT scores considered; scores are self-reported in MyPennState. No superscore (highest combined score from a single test date); ACT Science not accepted. Required for the Accelerated Premedical-Medical Program.

requirements.notes: Apply through MyPennState or the Common App (no preference). Application fee is $75 for international applicants ($65 domestic). International first-years self-report courses via the STARS record (South Korean system: official records at application). SAT/ACT only if you wish them considered or use them as English proof. The pages reviewed do not mention essays, recommendations or an interview.

deadlines.label: Early Action
deadlines.notes: Apply by Nov 1 to receive a decision by Dec 24.

deadlines.label: Recommended submission deadline for all applications
deadlines.notes: Penn State describes Dec 1 as the recommended submission date; its CDS reports no fixed application closing date. No regular-decision notification date is published on the page.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required of international students whose native language is not English (not required of US citizens/permanent residents). Alternatives: SAT EBRW 570+ (code 2660) or ACT English 24+ (code 3656), GCSE/GCE English language A-C, IB English A 5+, four years at a U.S. high school, or Penn State IECP certification. Scores must be under two years old; TOEFL MyBest not accepted.

english.notes: Exams taken before Jan 21, 2026; iBT Home Edition accepted.

aid.notes: "There is, at this time, essentially no financial aid available for international undergraduate students." Penn State Global lists two small tuition grants (SIGIA, PSTAG) for current students, typically $100 to $2,000.

majors.program: Computer Science (University Park, College of Engineering)
majors.notes: Students enter the College of Engineering or Undergraduate Studies, then apply for Entrance to Major after about 29 graded credits with required course grades; the bulletin notes administrative enrollment controls when space is limited (Penn State Bulletin, source etm).

ielts.note: The page gives no IELTS code; official reports must come directly from the testing service to Undergraduate Admissions.

duolingo.note: The page gives no Duolingo code; official reports must come directly from the testing service to Undergraduate Admissions.
